name: Whole-Relation Flattening Risk Audit Registry
purpose: Detect symbolic collapse of indivisible ⇔R relations into hidden equality, implication, composition, biconditional, arithmetic, or physics claims.

risk_categories.name: equality_flattening
risk_categories.description: Detects cases where ⇔R is treated as ordinary equality or substitutability.

risk_categories.name: implication_flattening
risk_categories.description: Detects cases where ⇔R is treated as directional implication or causal sequence.

risk_categories.name: composition_flattening
risk_categories.description: Detects cases where ⇔R is treated as ordered composition or process chaining.

risk_categories.name: biconditional_flattening
risk_categories.description: Detects cases where ⇔R is treated as ordinary logical iff.

risk_categories.name: arithmetic_escalation
risk_categories.description: Detects claims that process algebra replaces standard arithmetic or licenses numeric identities such as -1 = +1.

risk_categories.name: physics_escalation
risk_categories.description: Detects claims that process algebra proves physical reality, derives QM/GR, or establishes physical laws.

risk_categories.name: primitive_fragmentation
risk_categories.description: Detects unnecessary introduction of separate primitive operators that fragment ⇔R.

implication_flattening: A ⇔R B means A causes B
arithmetic_escalation: zero is impossible in standard math

severity_levels.MEDIUM: Projection loss missing or reduced form not marked.
severity_levels.HIGH: A projection is treated as primitive or ⇔R is flattened.
severity_levels.CRITICAL: Physics, arithmetic, or theorem escalation detected.
